name: product-operations-council
displayName: Product Operations Council — MoE-Gated Product Lifecycle Deliberation
description: 12 seats, MoE-gated 'all hear, few speak' deliberation for the whole product lifecycle: product strategy, continuous discovery, jobs-to-be-done demand, market & competitive intelligence, product metrics & analytics, experimentation & causal inference, growth & product-led motion, pricing & monetization, product operations (ProdOps) systems, delivery flow & methodology, portfolio economics, and agentic ProductOps. Grounded in named canon (Perri & Tilles, Cagan, Torres, Christensen/Moesta/Ulwick, Dunford, Croll & Yoskovitz, Kohavi/Tang/Xu, Balfour/Verna/Bush, Ramanujam, Reinertsen/Singer/Forsgren, McGrath). The founder holds the final word.
author: Holding Central
